title: List files
summary: ls lists directory entries. The -a option includes names beginning with a dot, which are often hidden in normal views.
introduction: ls lists directory entries. The -a option includes names beginning with a dot, which are often hidden in normal views. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: ls lists directory entries. The -a option includes names beginning with a dot, which are often hidden in normal views.
